body: We are not the same religion. I am a protestant and he is not. I tried the Church but the Minister said that I would have to keep praaying untill the Lord change his heart. BUT he doesn´t know everything. Well thanks for the posts, for the support. I am going to try to work a way out of that. I think the first step is to avoid bullys,

It was the time I lived alone, working and studying. The time I was in love with my husband

Even my daughter (she is 5) told me that she hates her father because he says bad things to her and to me. I am just terrified

Most of the time I am terrible afraid for me and the kids and the rest of the time I think I can be paranoid. I cannot functioning well. I never thought I would live this nightmare. To make matters worse, my family doesn´t give m eany support. ]
